text: The dam holds water to keep the village safe.
tagalog_text: Pinipigilan ng dam ang tubig upang panatilihing ligtas ang nayon.

text: Guardians protect the dam and the villagers.
tagalog_text: Pinoprotektahan ng mga tagapagbantay ang dam at ang mga tagabaryo.

text: The villagers live near the dam.

text: We must preserve the water and keep it clean.
tagalog_text: Dapat nating pangalagaan ang tubig at panatilihin itong malinis.

text: The mythical guardians are from a story.

text: One sunny Sunday, Bill, a clever monkey, found a shiny gold coin.
tagalog_text: Isang maaraw na Linggo, si Bill, isang matalinong unggoy, ay nakakita ng makinang na gintong barya.

text: Bill went to his friends, Warty Pig and Frog, and asked for advice.
tagalog_text: Lumapit si Bill sa kanyang mga kaibigan, sina Warty Pig at Frog, at humingi ng payo.

text: At the busy market, he found bananas on sale and said, 'How lucky!'
tagalog_text: Sa masiglang pamilihan, nakita niya ang mga saging na naka-sale at sinabi, 'Ang swerte!'

text: Bill became known as the smartest monkey in Pine Forest because he saved coins and bought cheap food.
tagalog_text: Nakilala si Bill bilang pinakamatalinong unggoy sa Pine Forest dahil nag-ipon siya ng barya at bumili ng murang pagkain.

text: I live in a small village.

text: My siblings save money for our father's birthday.
tagalog_text: Nag-iipon ng pera ang aking mga kapatid para sa kaarawan ng aming ama.

text: We have to use our talents to make other people happy.
tagalog_text: Kailangan naming gamitin ang aming mga talento upang pasayahin ang ibang tao.

text: I bought eleven pencils and seven notebooks.
tagalog_text: Bumili ako ng labing-isang lapis at pitong kuwaderno.

text: I saw a pilandok in the forest.

text: Maria had an idea, fun and bright. She wanted to guess and get it right.
tagalog_text: Nagkaroon si Maria ng ideya na masaya at mahusay. Gusto niyang manghula at tamaan ang sagot.

text: Maria practiced without fear because her math quiz was coming near.
tagalog_text: Nagpraktis si Maria nang walang takot dahil malapit na ang kanyang pagsusulit sa matematika.

text: If they're parallel, they'll never touch, side by side!
tagalog_text: Kung parallel ang mga ito, hindi sila kailanman magtatagpo, magkatabi lamang!

text: If they intersect, they cross just so, making angles!
tagalog_text: Kung nag-iintersect ang mga ito, nagkakasalubong sila at bumubuo ng mga anggulo!

text: Maria smiled with shining eyes after she saw her test result.
tagalog_text: Ngumiti si Maria nang may kumikislap na mga mata matapos niyang makita ang resulta ng kanyang pagsusulit.

text: Exploring the stems and leaves, the kitten discovered a world full of wonders.
tagalog_text: Habang sinusuri ang mga tangkay at dahon, natuklasan ng kuting ang mundong puno ng mga kababalaghan.

text: With gratitude in our hearts, we humbly pray for guidance and love.
tagalog_text: May pasasalamat sa aming mga puso, kami ay mapagkumbabang nananalangin para sa gabay at pagmamahal.

text: Recycle, reduce, and reuse to help protect the Earth.
tagalog_text: Mag-recycle, magbawas, at muling gamitin upang maprotektahan ang mundo.

text: Beneath the vast sky, the kitten found its place in the world.
tagalog_text: Sa ilalim ng napakalawak na langit, natagpuan ng kuting ang kanyang lugar sa mundo.

text: Thousands of years ago, stones were necessary for survival. Early humans used stones as tools or weapons.
tagalog_text: Noong libu-libong taon na ang nakalipas, mahalaga ang mga bato para mabuhay ang mga sinaunang tao. Ginagamit nila ang mga bato bilang kasangkapan o sandata.

text: After several years, everything changed when metals were discovered. Metals improved many aspects of their lives.
tagalog_text: Pagkaraan ng maraming taon, may nagbago nang matuklasan ang mga metal. Pinaganda ng mga metal ang maraming bahagi ng buhay ng mga tao.

text: Iron is a shiny, sturdy metal used to make tools, machinery, and structures. It is also used to make steel for buildings and bridges.
tagalog_text: Ang bakal ay isang makinang at matibay na metal. Ginagamit ito sa paggawa ng mga kasangkapan, makina, at mga gusali. Ginagamit din ito sa paggawa ng bakal para sa mga tulay at gusali.

text: Aluminum is soft, lightweight, and corrosion-resistant. It is used in beverage cans, window frames, and airplanes.
tagalog_text: Ang aluminyo ay malambot, magaan, at hindi madaling kalawangin. Ginagamit ito sa mga lata ng inumin, bintana, at eroplano.

text: Copper is reddish-brown and conducts electricity well. It is used in electrical wires, pipes, and coins.
tagalog_text: Ang tanso ay kulay mapula-kayumanggi at mahusay magdala ng kuryente. Ginagamit ito sa mga kawad ng kuryente, tubo, at barya.

text: Clay is a special kind of soil from the ground that people have used for thousands of years to make many things. When clay is wet, it feels smooth and sticky. People can mold it into many different shapes. After some time, the clay dries. When it dries, it becomes hard and strong. Because of these qualities, clay is useful for making many objects.
tagalog_text: Ang luwad ay isang uri ng lupa na matatagpuan sa ilalim ng lupa. Ginagamit ito ng mga tao sa loob ng libu-libong taon upang gumawa ng iba't ibang bagay. Kapag basa ang luwad, ito ay makinis at malagkit. Maaari itong hubugin sa iba�t ibang anyo. Kapag natuyo na, ito ay tumitigas at nagiging matibay.

text: People have used clay to make pottery for thousands of years. Pottery is one of the oldest human crafts. Clay can be shaped into bowls, pots, and other containers. Some pottery is useful for holding food or water. Other pottery is decorative and used to make homes look beautiful. Because clay is easy to shape, it is perfect for making pottery.
tagalog_text: Ginagamit ang luwad sa paggawa ng palayok sa loob ng napakahabang panahon. Ang palayok ay isa sa pinakamatandang sining ng tao. Maaaring gawing mangkok, paso, at iba pang lalagyan ang luwad.

text: Clay is also used by artists. Artists shape clay to create sculptures. Sculptures are figures or objects made for art. They can be big or small and come in many shapes. Some sculptures are placed in museums for people to see. In school, students can also use clay to make models or fun shapes.
tagalog_text: Ginagamit din ng mga alagad ng sining ang luwad upang gumawa ng mga iskultura. Ang iskultura ay mga hugis o bagay na ginawa bilang sining.

text: Clay is also useful for building houses. People shape clay into bricks. After the bricks dry, they become very strong. Builders can use these bricks to make walls and buildings. In the past, some houses were made completely from clay bricks. This shows how useful clay can be in construction.
tagalog_text: Ginagamit din ang luwad sa paggawa ng mga bahay. Ginagawang ladrilyo ang luwad. Kapag natuyo ang mga ladrilyo, nagiging matibay ang mga ito.

text: Even though clay is very useful, it can cause problems when it gets wet. Wet clay can expand and become slippery. Because of this, the ground may become unstable. Houses built on clay soil might sink or crack. However, people have found ways to solve this problem. Builders mix other materials with clay to make the soil stronger and more stable.
tagalog_text: Kapag masyadong basa ang luwad, maaari itong maging madulas at lumawak. Dahil dito, maaaring maging hindi matatag ang lupa.

text: Wrapping a gift can make it look more special. To begin, you need to choose a box that fits the size of your gift. The box can be square or rectangular. Using the right size box helps the wrapping paper cover the gift properly. If the box is too big or too small, the paper may not wrap neatly.
tagalog_text: Ang pagbalot ng regalo ay nagpapaganda nito. Una, pumili ng kahon na akma sa laki ng regalo.

text: After choosing the box, the next step is to prepare the wrapping paper. Unroll the wrapping paper on a flat surface. Then place the box upside down in the middle of the paper. This position helps you measure how much paper you will need. It also helps make sure the paper can wrap around the whole box.
tagalog_text: Ilapag ang papel na pambalot sa patag na lugar. Ilagay ang kahon nang baliktad sa gitna ng papel.

text: Once the box is placed on the wrapping paper, the paper is folded over the box. This helps you see how much extra paper should be cut. Cutting the correct amount of paper is important. If there is too much paper, the wrapping will look messy. If there is too little paper, the gift may not be fully covered.
tagalog_text: Kapag kulang ang papel na pambalot, maaaring hindi matakpan nang buo ang regalo.

text: After measuring and cutting the paper, the sides of the wrapping paper are folded over the box. Tape is used to secure the paper in place. The corners are also folded neatly so the box looks clean and organized. The same process is repeated on the other side of the box. Doing these steps carefully helps the wrapped gift look neat.
tagalog_text: Pagkatapos sukatin at gupitin ang papel, ang mga gilid ng pambalot na papel ay nakatiklop sa ibabaw ng kahon. Ang tape ay ginagamit upang i-secure ang papel sa lugar. Ang mga sulok ay nakatiklop din nang maayos upang ang kahon ay mukhang malinis at maayos. Ang parehong proseso ay paulit-ulit sa kabilang panig ng kahon. Ang maingat na paggawa ng mga hakbang na ito ay nakakatulong na magmukhang maayos ang nakabalot na regalo.

text: Finally, decorations can be added to make the gift more attractive. A ribbon can be tied around the box, and a greeting card may be attached. Words such as first, next, then, and finally help readers understand the order of steps in the instructions. These words are called discourse markers. They help organize ideas and make the directions easier to follow.
tagalog_text: Sa wakas, maaaring magdagdag ng mga dekorasyon upang gawing mas kaakit-akit ang regalo. Ang isang laso ay maaaring itali sa paligid ng kahon, at isang greeting card ay maaaring nakalakip. Ang mga salita tulad ng una, susunod, pagkatapos, at panghuli ay tumutulong sa mga mambabasa na maunawaan ang pagkakasunud-sunod ng mga hakbang sa mga tagubilin. Ang mga salitang ito ay tinatawag na mga pananda ng diskurso. Tumutulong sila sa pag-aayos ng mga ideya at gawing mas madaling sundin ang mga direksyon.

text: The coconut tree is often called the 'Tree of Life.' It grows tall and has big leaves and round coconuts. Almost every part of the tree is useful to people. The coconuts contain sweet water and soft white meat that people eat. Because it provides many useful things, the coconut tree is very important in many places.
tagalog_text: Ang puno ng niyog ay madalas na tinatawag na 'Puno ng Buhay.' Matangkad ito at may malalaking dahon at bilog na niyog. Halos lahat ng bahagi ng puno ay kapaki-pakinabang sa mga tao. Ang mga niyog ay naglalaman ng matamis na tubig at malambot na puting karne na kinakain ng mga tao. Dahil nagbibigay ito ng maraming kapaki-pakinabang na bagay, ang puno ng niyog ay napakahalaga sa maraming lugar.

text: The coconut tree provides many materials people can use every day. Its trunk is strong and can be used to build houses. Its large leaves can be made into roofs. The fruit gives coconut water and meat used in many Filipino dishes. People can also make ropes, mats, baskets, and coconut oil from different parts of the tree.
tagalog_text: Ang puno ng niyog ay nagbibigay ng maraming materyales na magagamit ng mga tao araw-araw. Matibay ang baul nito at maaaring gamitin sa pagtatayo ng mga bahay. Ang malalaking dahon nito ay maaaring gawing bubong. Ang prutas ay nagbibigay ng tubig ng niyog at karne na ginagamit sa maraming lutuing Pilipino. Ang mga tao ay maaari ding gumawa ng mga lubid, banig, basket, at langis ng niyog mula sa iba't ibang bahagi ng puno.

text: The coconut tree also helps the environment. Its deep roots hold the soil firmly in place. Because of this, the soil is less likely to wash away during heavy rain. This helps reduce flooding in some areas. Trees like the coconut tree play an important role in protecting the land.
tagalog_text: Nakakatulong din ang puno ng niyog sa kapaligiran. Ang malalalim na ugat nito ang humahawak sa lupa nang matatag. Dahil dito, ang lupa ay mas malamang na mahugasan sa panahon ng malakas na ulan. Nakakatulong ito na mabawasan ang pagbaha sa ilang lugar. Ang mga puno tulad ng puno ng niyog ay may mahalagang papel sa pagprotekta sa lupa.

text: Coconut trees also help people earn money. Farmers harvest coconuts and sell them in markets. Coconut products such as oil, baskets, and ropes can also be sold. Because of this, the coconut tree helps support many families and communities.
tagalog_text: Ang mga puno ng niyog ay tumutulong din sa mga tao na kumita ng pera. Ang mga magsasaka ay umaani ng niyog at ibinebenta sa mga palengke. Maaari ding ibenta ang mga produktong niyog tulad ng mantika, basket, at lubid. Dahil dito, nakakatulong ang puno ng niyog sa pagsuporta sa maraming pamilya at komunidad.

text: The coconut tree provides food, shelter, and materials for many useful products. It also protects the soil and helps farmers earn a living. Because of these benefits, people should protect coconut trees. Taking care of these trees helps both people and nature.
tagalog_text: Ang puno ng niyog ay nagbibigay ng pagkain, tirahan, at mga materyales para sa maraming kapaki-pakinabang na produkto. Pinoprotektahan din nito ang lupa at tinutulungan ang mga magsasaka na maghanapbuhay. Dahil sa mga benepisyong ito, dapat protektahan ng mga tao ang mga puno ng niyog. Ang pag-aalaga sa mga punong ito ay nakakatulong kapwa sa tao at kalikasan.

text: The butanding, or whale shark, is the largest fish in the world. Even though it is very large, it is gentle and does not harm people. It swims slowly through the ocean and feeds on tiny organisms called plankton. Because it eats such small food, it does not attack other sea animals. This makes the butanding very different from many other large ocean creatures.
tagalog_text: Ang butanding, o whale shark, ay ang pinakamalaking isda sa mundo. Kahit na ito ay napakalaki, ito ay banayad at hindi nakakapinsala sa mga tao. Mabagal itong lumalangoy sa karagatan at kumakain ng maliliit na organismo na tinatawag na plankton. Dahil kumakain ito ng napakaliit na pagkain, hindi ito umaatake sa ibang mga hayop sa dagat. Ito ang dahilan kung bakit ang butanding ay ibang-iba sa maraming iba pang malalaking nilalang sa karagatan.

text: The butanding has a very wide mouth that helps it catch plankton. It swims close to the surface of the ocean while feeding. By eating plankton, it helps control the number of these tiny organisms in the water. This helps keep the ocean environment balanced and healthy for other sea animals.
tagalog_text: Ang butanding ay may napakalawak na bibig na tumutulong sa paghuli nito ng plankton. Lumalangoy ito malapit sa ibabaw ng karagatan habang kumakain. Sa pamamagitan ng pagkain ng plankton, nakakatulong itong kontrolin ang bilang ng maliliit na organismong ito sa tubig. Nakakatulong ito na panatilihing balanse at malusog ang kapaligiran ng karagatan para sa iba pang mga hayop sa dagat.

text: In the Philippines, butanding can be found in places such as Donsol and Oslob. Many tourists visit these places to see the whale sharks. Because people enjoy watching butanding, tourism grows in these areas. This helps local communities earn income while learning the importance of protecting marine animals.
tagalog_text: Sa Pilipinas, makikita ang butanding sa mga lugar tulad ng Donsol at Oslob. Maraming turista ang bumibisita sa mga lugar na ito para makita ang mga whale shark. Dahil natutuwa ang mga tao sa panonood ng butanding, lumalago ang turismo sa mga lugar na ito. Nakakatulong ito sa mga lokal na komunidad na kumita habang natutunan ang kahalagahan ng pagprotekta sa mga hayop sa dagat.

text: The butanding is an important part of nature's balance. When animals in the ocean are protected, the environment becomes healthier. Scientists and communities encourage people to take care of the ocean by reducing pollution and protecting marine life.
tagalog_text: Ang butanding ay isang mahalagang bahagi ng balanse ng kalikasan. Kapag ang mga hayop sa karagatan ay protektado, ang kapaligiran ay nagiging mas malusog. Hinihikayat ng mga siyentipiko at komunidad ang mga tao na pangalagaan ang karagatan sa pamamagitan ng pagbabawas ng polusyon at pagprotekta sa buhay dagat.

text: The butanding shows how animals, people, and nature are connected. Tourists travel to see them, scientists study them, and communities work to protect them. If people stop caring for the ocean, these gentle giants could disappear. Protecting nature helps ensure that future generations can continue to see and learn from these amazing animals.
tagalog_text: Ang butanding ay nagpapakita kung paano konektado ang mga hayop, tao, at kalikasan. Naglalakbay ang mga turista upang makita sila, pinag-aaralan sila ng mga siyentipiko, at nagtatrabaho ang mga komunidad upang protektahan sila. Kung titigil ang mga tao sa pag-aalaga sa karagatan, maaaring mawala ang magiliw na mga higanteng ito. Ang pagprotekta sa kalikasan ay nakakatulong na matiyak na ang mga susunod na henerasyon ay patuloy na makakakita at matuto mula sa mga kamangha-manghang hayop na ito.

text: One day, a giant eagle came from the blue sky. It took the town's food and flew to its high nest. They shouted, 'That food is ours!' but the eagle did not listen. The people cried, 'Please help us, mighty Apo!'
tagalog_text: none

text: Apo rose and ran up the big hill to ask for food. When he saw the eagle sit, he gently said, 'Good day, mighty eagle. Please be noble and return the food. That food is theirs. The people need this to live.'
tagalog_text: none

text: The eagle rose and said, 'How dare you face me? Why should I listen to you? This food is mine.' Apo answered calmly with care. The eagle felt his sincerity and was amazed by his bravery. The eagle gave the food back and flew away.
tagalog_text: none

text: Then, the gods spoke. 'Apo, you have been good and true. Now, you will guard this land forever. This land is yours.' A great fire shone, and Apo became a high hill.
tagalog_text: none

text: The people named it Mount Apo to honor him. From that day on, the people knew that they were always safe. Those who pass by remember his name and tell his tale.
tagalog_text: none

text: In the green valleys of Montalban, Rizal, Bernardo, and Maria, the mythical guardians of Wawa Dam, faced a new challenge. They discovered villagers thoughtlessly dumping trash into the water. They greeted the villagers warmly with 'Good morning.'
tagalog_text: none

text: Bernardo and Maria felt it was important to share with every villager that proper waste disposal is a key measure in preventing harmful chemicals and pollutants from polluting soil, water sources, and the environment. They expressed their gratitude to the community, saying, 'Thank you for taking the time to learn and help us in this important task.' Educating others was a crucial part of their mission to protect the dam and preserve the environment.
tagalog_text: none

text: Surprised by the mythical guardians of Wawa Dam's unexpected presence, the villagers realized the dam's gift and their oversight. From that moment on, they promised to throw away their waste correctly. This proves Maria and Bernardo's transformative influence and the potential for positive change. One evening, a lump appeared in the dam's wall. Maria and Bernardo repaired it under the dark sky using magic, pushing, pulling, and carrying rocks.
tagalog_text: none

text: They estimated the area they needed to cover using square tile units as they worked. For instance, if they had a rectangular section of the wall that was 5 miles long and 3 miles wide, they calculated the area by multiplying the length by the width. Their formula was $Area = length \times width$, $5\ miles \times 3\ miles = 15\ square\ tile\ units$. This estimation helped them determine how many rocks they needed to repair the dam efficiently. After that, they weaved a belt from tall grasses to calm the wind and shield the dam from stone fragments.
tagalog_text: none

text: Then, the old spirit threatened to stop the water from flowing through the fields. 'These conditions are testing our skills,' Maria shouted. They worked together and did their best to shield the dam from stone fragments. 'That field needs water,' Bernardo said, pointing to a dried land area. Demonstrating their water management skills and respect for nature convinced the old spirit to sympathize with and preserve their beloved dam. As time passed, it became clear that Bernardo and Maria were not just guardians of the dam but also the land. Every problem they overcame as guardians of Wawa Dam secured their constant commitment to environmental conservation, giving them confidence and a sense of security.
tagalog_text: none

text: One sunny Sunday in the enchanting Pine Forest, Bill, a clever monkey, found a shiny gold coin. Wondering what to do with it, he went to his friends, Warty Pig and Frog, and asked, 'Who can help me use this gold coin well?' Warty Pig suggested, 'Why not save it for later?' and Frog added, 'Where can you buy cheap things?'
tagalog_text: none

text: Bill listened carefully to his friends. He was glad to have such wise friends and decided to follow their advice. He went to the busy market. There, he found bananas on sale and said, 'How lucky!' Feeling happy and wise, he bought some bananas and saved the change.
tagalog_text: none

text: As time passed, Bill became known as the smartest monkey in Pine Forest. He diligently saved coins and bought cheap food. His plan worked perfectly, setting an example for his friends and other animals in the forest on how to be smart with money. Bill's wise choices taught everyone important lessons and made him a popular animal in the forest community.
tagalog_text: none

text: The next step for Bill was to teach his friends how to manage their coins as well. He gathered them together and shared his strategies, helping them all to become smarter with their money.
tagalog_text: none

text: Bill, now known as the smartest monkey in Pine Forest, decided to save more money. One day, he found a small box and thought, 'This will be my money box.' Bill placed it on a square table in his cozy treehouse.
tagalog_text: none

text: One morning, Bill heard about a new store in town that sold tools and fruits. Excited, he asked his friends, 'Who wants to visit the new shop with me?' Warty Pig and Frog eagerly agreed.
tagalog_text: none

text: At the store, Bill saw many useful things. He thought about buying a shiny red rake, a lovely green ball, a round juicy plum and a fresh bunch of grapes. However, he remembered his goal to save money. Bill bought only the grapes and kept the rest of his coins in his money box.
tagalog_text: none

text: Later, they decided to visit the river. They love to swim in the water and play games by the shore. Then, Bill and his friends sat on a log near the river and talked about their day. Frog asked, 'Why did you buy only the grapes?' Bill smiled and said, 'I'm saving my money for something special.'
tagalog_text: none

text: Bill's wise choices inspired his friends. They decided to save their money too. Frog saved for a new book, and Warty Pig saved for a new blanket. By using their money wisely, Bill and his friends learned the importance of saving for the future. Through this, Bill taught everyone that being careful with money and making smart choices could lead to greater happiness and success in their community.
tagalog_text: none

text: Pilo is a pilandok. Pilo is kind.
tagalog_text: Si Pilo ay pilandok. Mabait si Pilo.

text: Pilo walked in the forest. He found some coins.
tagalog_text: Lumakad si Pilo sa gubat. Nakakita siya ng barya.

text: Pilo saved the coins. He did not spend them.
tagalog_text: Inipon ni Pilo ang barya. Hindi niya ginastos.

text: Pilo loves to paint. He painted every day.
tagalog_text: Si Pilo ay mahilig magpinta. Nagpinta siya araw-araw.

text: Pilo's work was beautiful. A lady bought one of his paintings.
tagalog_text: Maganda ang gawa ni Pilo. Binili ng isang babae ang obra.

text: Summer came. There was very little food.
tagalog_text: Dumating ang tag-init. Kakaunti ang pagkain.

text: Pilo had food. He gave it to others.
tagalog_text: May pagkain si Pilo. Ibinigay niya ito sa iba.

text: Everyone was thankful. The village was happy.
tagalog_text: Nagpasalamat ang lahat. Masaya ang nayon.

text: Maria was excited. She had a math quiz tomorrow. She sat at her desk and opened her notebook.
tagalog_text: Nasabik si Maria. Mayroon siyang pagsusulit sa math bukas. Umupo siya sa kanyang mesa at binuksan ang kanyang kuwaderno.

text: 'Study hard,' said her teacher. 'Practice before bed!' Maria remembered those words.
tagalog_text: 'Mag-aral nang mabuti,' sabi ng kanyang guro. 'Mag-ensayo bago matulog!' Naalala ni Maria ang mga salitang iyon.

text: 'Do your best!' said Mom with a smile. 'Learning takes work, but it is worth it!'. Maria nodded and smiled back.
tagalog_text: 'Gawin mo ang iyong makakaya!' sabi ni Nanay na may ngiti. 'Ang pag-aaral ay mahirap, ngunit sulit ito!' Tumango si Maria at ngumiti rin.

text: Maria drew two long lines on her paper. She guessed, 'Will they ever meet?' 'If they are parallel, they go side by side. They never touch!'
tagalog_text: Gumuhit si Maria ng dalawang mahabang linya sa papel. Hula niya, 'Magtatagpo ba sila?' 'Kung sila ay parallel, nagtatakbo sila nang magkatabi. Hindi sila nagtatagpo!'

text: 'If they are perpendicular, they make a cross!' 'They meet at a right angle — just like a T!' Maria drew the lines and checked her answer.
tagalog_text: 'Kung sila ay perpendicular, gumagawa sila ng krus!' 'Sa right angle sila nagtatagpo — tulad ng letra T!' Gumuhit si Maria ng mga linya at sinuri ang kanyang sagot.

text: 'If they intersect, they cross and make angles!' 'Some angles are big. Some are small.' Maria smiled. Her guesses were right!
tagalog_text: 'Kung sila ay nag-iintersect, nagtatawid sila at gumagawa ng mga anggulo!' 'Ang ilang anggulo ay malaki. Ang iba ay maliit.' Ngumiti si Maria. Tama ang kanyang mga hula!

text: The next day, Maria took her test. She tried her best and answered each question. She felt calm and ready.
tagalog_text: Kinabukasan, kumuha si Maria ng pagsusulit. Ginawa niya ang kanyang makakaya at sinagot ang bawat tanong. Naramdaman niyang panatag at handa siya.

text: Her teacher gave back the papers. Maria looked at her score. She smiled with shining eyes — she did great!
tagalog_text: Ibinigay ng guro ang mga papel. Tiningnan ni Maria ang kanyang marka. Ngumiti siya nang may maliwanag na mga mata — napakahusay niya!

text: One warm summer day, a small kitten was found sleeping in the garden. She was curled up tightly between the plants, not making a sound. Her fur was soft, and she looked very tired.
tagalog_text: Isang mainit na araw ng tag-araw, isang munting kuting ang natagpuan sa hardin. Siya ay nakaunat sa pagitan ng mga halaman, tahimik at walang kilos. Malambot ang kanyang balahibo, at mukhang napagod siya nang husto.

text: The kitten woke up slowly and looked around. She saw tall green stems and wide, bright leaves all around her. She did not know where she was, and she felt a little scared.
tagalog_text: Dahan-dahang nagising ang kuting at tumingin sa paligid. Nakita niya ang matatangkad na tangkay at malalaking berdeng dahon sa lahat ng panig. Hindi niya alam kung nasaan siya, at naramdaman niya ang kaunting takot.

text: But then, the warm sunlight touched her fur, and she began to feel better. She started to sniff the flowers and tap the leaves with her tiny paws. Soon, she was playing happily in the garden.
tagalog_text: Ngunit nang maramdaman niya ang mainit na sikat ng araw sa kanyang balahibo, nagsimula siyang gumaan ang loob. Naamoy niya ang mga bulaklak at hinawakan ang mga dahon gamit ang kanyang maliliit na paa. Hindi nagtagal, masaya na siyang naglalaro sa hardin.

text: As the sun went down, the sky turned dark and the stars came out. The kitten looked up and saw thousands of tiny lights above her. She sat very still and stared at the beautiful night sky.
tagalog_text: Nang lumubog ang araw, naging madilim ang langit at lumabas ang mga bituin. Tumingin ang kuting sa itaas at nakita niya ang libu-libong maliliit na liwanag. Nanatiling tahimik siya at pinagmasdan ang magandang gabi.

text: The kitten felt thankful. She had food to eat, a garden to play in, and a warm sky above her. She bowed her little head, as if saying a quiet thank-you for the day.
tagalog_text: Naramdaman ng kuting ang pasasalamat sa kanyang puso. Mayroon siyang pagkain, isang hardin na nilalaro, at isang mainit na langit sa itaas. Yumuko ang kanyang munting ulo, na parang nagpapasalamat nang tahimik sa magandang araw.

text: The next morning, the kitten saw some trash near the flowers. The leaves looked sad, and the soil was dirty. She remembered how beautiful the garden was, and she wanted to fix it.
tagalog_text: Kinabukasan, nakita ng kuting ang ilang basura malapit sa mga bulaklak. Mukhang malungkot ang mga dahon, at marumi ang lupa. Naalala niya kung gaano kaganda ang hardin, at nais niyang ayusin ito.

text: So the kitten pushed the trash away from the flowers with her paws. She dug gently in the soil and helped the bent stems stand up straight again. She worked hard because she loved the garden.
tagalog_text: Kaya itinulak ng kuting ang mga basura palayo sa mga bulaklak gamit ang kanyang mga paa. Maingat siyang humukay sa lupa at tinulungang tumayo ulit ang mga nakayukong tangkay. Nagsumikap siya dahil mahal niya ang hardin.

text: When she was done, the garden looked clean and bright again. The flowers bloomed, the leaves were green, and the air smelled fresh. The kitten purred loudly because she was very happy. The garden was her home, and she would always take care of it.
tagalog_text: Nang matapos siya, malinis at maliwanag na muli ang hardin. Namukadkad ang mga bulaklak, berde ang mga dahon, at sariwang-sariwa ang hangin. Malakas na nag-ngiyaw ang kuting dahil labis siyang nagagalak. Ang hardin ay kanyang tahanan, at lagi niyang aalagaan ito.

text: Emma and her brother Max had been watching the empty garden bed for days. 'It looks lonely,' Emma said softly, pressing her hand into the dry soil. Max had an idea that made his eyes light up. 'Let's plant something,' he said. 'We can ask Lola Ceding next door — she knows everything about plants!'
tagalog_text: Ilang araw nang pinagmamasdan nina Emma at ng kanyang kapatid na si Max ang walang taniming taniman. 'Mukhang malungkot,' sabi ni Emma nang marahil habang hinahawakan ang tuyong lupa. Naisip agad ni Max ang isang bagay at nagniningning ang kanyang mga mata. 'Magtanim tayo ng halaman,' sabi niya. 'Makikiusap tayo kay Lola Ceding sa tabi — alam niya ang lahat tungkol sa mga halaman!'

text: Lola Ceding shuffled over with a big smile and a small wooden box. Inside were tiny seeds, a little trowel, and a folded piece of paper. 'This is my secret map,' she whispered, unfolding it to reveal a hand-drawn planting guide. Emma's heart raced with excitement. Max leaned in so close that Lola Ceding laughed and gently pushed him back.
tagalog_text: Dahan-dahang lumapit si Lola Ceding na may malaking ngiti at isang maliit na kahong gawa sa kahoy. Sa loob nito ay may maliliit na buto, isang maliit na pala, at isang tiklop na papel. 'Ito ang aking lihim na mapa,' bulong niya habang binubuksan ang papel na may kamay-guhit na gabay sa pagtatanim. Bumilis ang tibok ng puso ni Emma sa kasiyahan. Sumingit naman si Max nang napakalapit kaya tumawa si Lola Ceding at malambing siyang itinulak papalayo.

text: Following Lola Ceding's map, the three of them got to work. First, they pulled out the weeds together — it was harder than it looked, and Max tumbled backward into the grass, making everyone giggle. Then, they filled small pots with soft, dark soil and poked little holes with their fingers, careful to make each one just right.
tagalog_text: Sinunod nila ang mapa ni Lola Ceding at nagsimula silang magtrabaho. Una, sabay-sabay nilang hinugot ang mga damo — mas mahirap pala ito kaysa sa akala nila, at natumba si Max sa damuhan, kaya nagtawanan sila lahat. Pagkatapos, pinuno nila ng malambot at maitim na lupa ang maliliit na paso at gumawa ng maliliit na butas gamit ang kanilang mga daliri, maingat na ginawa nang tama ang bawat isa.

text: Carefully, they each dropped a seed into a hole and covered it with soil like tucking it into bed. 'Do you think they can hear us?' Emma whispered, leaning close to the pots. Lola Ceding smiled. 'Maybe. So speak kindly to them.' Max looked unsure, but then leaned over and said, 'Good luck, little seed.' And somehow, it didn't feel silly at all.
tagalog_text: Maingat nilang inilagay ang bawat buto sa bawat butas at tinakpan ng lupa, parang sinasabitan ito ng kumot bago matulog. 'Sa palagay mo ba, naririnig nila tayo?' bulong ni Emma habang yumuyuko sa mga paso. Ngumiti si Lola Ceding. 'Marahil. Kaya magsalita ka nang mabuti sa kanila.' Nagduda si Max, pero yumuko rin siya at nagsabi, 'Suwerte sa iyo, maliit na buto.' At sa isang kakaibang paraan, hindi ito nakakatawang-masama ni hindi man lang.

text: Together, they watered the seeds gently — not too much, just enough. Then they carried the pots to the sunniest corner of the garden. Lola Ceding said the sun was like a warm hug for growing things. Weeks passed, and one morning Emma ran outside to find tiny green sprouts reaching upward. She called for Max, and they both stood there, silent for a moment, amazed.
tagalog_text: Magkasama nilang dinilig ang mga buto nang marahil — hindi masyadong marami, sapat na lang. Pagkatapos, dinala nila ang mga paso sa pinakamaliwanag na sulok ng hardin. Sinabi ni Lola Ceding na ang araw ay parang mainit na yakap para sa mga tumutubo. Lumipas ang mga linggo, at isang umaga ay tumakbo si Emma palabas at nakita ang maliliit na berdeng usbong na paakyat. Tinawag niya si Max, at silang dalawa ay nakatayo nang sandali, tahimik at namamangha.

text: That afternoon, they brought Lola Ceding over to see. Her eyes grew soft and shiny. 'You did this,' she said quietly. 'You gave them what they needed.' Emma felt something warm bloom in her chest — like the feeling of being trusted with something precious. Max was already asking what they should plant next. Lola Ceding just laughed and pulled out another folded map.
Bathala looked at the world. It was dark and lonely. He wanted to make it beautiful.
tagalog_text: "Tumingin si Bathala sa mundo. Ito ay madilim at malungkot. Nais niyang gawing maganda ito."

text: Bathala used his strong hands. He shaped the land and the seas. Mountains and rivers appeared one by one.
tagalog_text: Ginamit ni Bathala ang kanyang malakas na mga kamay. Hinubog niya ang lupa at mga dagat. Isa isang lumitaw ang mga bundok at ilog.

text: Stars lit up the night sky. The sun and moon shone bright. The world was no longer dark.
tagalog_text: Nag-liwanag ang mga bituin sa gabi. Ang araw at buwan ay kuminang. Hindi na madilim ang mundo.

text: Strong winds blew across the land. The seas danced with big waves. Plants and trees began to grow.
tagalog_text: Malakas na hangin ang humihip sa lupain. Ang mga dagat ay sumayaw kasama ang malaking alon. Ang mga halaman at puno ay nagsimulang lumaki.

text: Big trees grew tall and straight. Birds flew and sang in the sky. Small creatures swam in the sea.
tagalog_text: Ang malalaking puno ay lumaki nang matangkad at tuwid. Ang mga ibon ay lumipad at kumanta sa langit. Ang maliliit na nilalang ay lumangoy sa dagat.

text: Eggs hatched and new life came. Big and small animals appeared. Many islands rose from the sea.
tagalog_text: Ang mga itlog ay napisa at dumating ang bagong buhay. Lumabas ang malalaki at maliliit na hayop. Maraming pulo ang lumitaw mula sa dagat.

text: A man and a woman came out of a bamboo. They were good and kind. From them, many people were born.
tagalog_text: Isang lalaki at isang babae ang lumabas mula sa kawayan. Sila ay mabait at mabuti. Mula sa kanila, maraming tao ang ipinanganak.

text: People filled the islands. They sang songs and lived together. Bathala smiled. The world was no longer lonely.
tagalog_text: Ang mga pulo ay napuno ng mga tao. Kumanta sila at namuhay nang magkasama. Ngumiti si Bathala. Hindi na malungkot ang mundo.

text: Emma is a student who loves science class. One day, her teacher wrote a big number on the board: 1,234. Emma looked at it and felt confused. 'How do I read this' she wondered.
tagalog_text: Si Emma ay isang mag-aaral na mahilig sa klase ng agham. Isang araw, isinulat ng kanyang guro ang isang malaking numero sa pisara: 1,234. Tumingin si Emma at nagtaka siya. 'Paano ko ito mababasa?' ang tanong niya sa sarili.

text: Her teacher, Ms. Reyes, smiled and walked to the board. 'I will help you, Emma,' she said. 'Every digit has its own special place.' She pointed to each number slowly. 'The 4 is in the ones place. The 3 is in the tens place.'
tagalog_text: Ngumiti ang kanyang guro na si Gng. Reyes at lumapit sa pisara. 'Tutulungan kita, Emma,' sabi niya. 'Ang bawat digit ay may sariling espesyal na lugar.' Itinuro niya ang bawat numero nang dahan-dahan. 'Ang 4 ay nasa ones place. Ang 3 ay nasa tens place.'

text: Ms. Reyes continued. 'The 2 is in the hundreds place. And the 1 is in the thousands place.' 'So together, we read it as: one thousand, two hundred thirty-four.' Emma repeated it softly. 'One thousand, two hundred thirty-four,' she said. She was starting to understand!
tagalog_text: Nagpatuloy si Gng. Reyes. 'Ang 2 ay nasa hundreds place. At ang 1 ay nasa thousands place.' 'Kaya sama-sama, binabasa natin ito bilang: isang libo, dalawang daan tatlumpu't apat.' Inulit ito ni Emma nang marahan. 'Isang libo, dalawang daan tatlumpu't apat,' sabi niya. Unti-unti na siyang nakakaunawa!

text: Then Ms. Reyes wrote a new number: 6,785. 'Your turn, Emma. Can you read this one?' Emma felt nervous. What if she made a mistake? She took a deep breath and looked carefully at each digit.
tagalog_text: Pagkatapos, sumulat si Gng. Reyes ng bagong numero: 6,785. 'Ikaw na, Emma. Kaya mo bang basahin ito?' Kinabahan si Emma. Paano kung magkamali siya? Huminga siya nang malalim at maingat na tiningnan ang bawat numero.

text: '6 is in the thousands place,' Emma said slowly. '7 is in the hundreds place. 8 is in the tens place. And 5 is in the ones place.' She smiled. 'So it is six thousand, seven hundred eighty-five!' The class clapped. Emma did it!
tagalog_text: 'Ang 6 ay nasa thousands place,' sabi ni Emma nang dahan-dahan. 'Ang 7 ay nasa hundreds place. Ang 8 ay nasa tens place. At ang 5 ay nasa ones place.' Ngumiti siya. 'Kaya ito ay anim na libo, pitong daan walumpu't lima!' Pumalo ng palakpak ang klase. Nagawa ni Emma!

text: After class, Emma practiced reading more numbers at her desk. Every time she made a mistake, she tried again. She was not afraid anymore. 'If I look at each place carefully, I can read any number!' she thought.
tagalog_text: Pagkatapos ng klase, nag-ensayo si Emma ng pagbabasa ng mas maraming numero sa kanyang mesa. Sa tuwing nagkakamali siya, sumusubok siyang muli. Hindi na siya natatakot. 'Kung maingat akong titingin sa bawat lugar, kaya kong basahin ang anumang numero!' ang naisip niya.

text: From that day on, numbers were no longer a problem for Emma. She learned that when something is hard, you just need to look at it one piece at a time.
tagalog_text: Mula noon, hindi na problema para kay Emma ang mga numero. Natutunan niya na kapag mahirap ang isang bagay, kailangan mo lang itong unti-untiin.

text: Tom has a dog. The dog is big. Tom feeds the dog every day. The dog wags its tail. Tom is happy.

Ana woke up early on Monday. She helped her mother cook breakfast. Then she packed her bag and walked to school. At school, she gave her teacher a flower from their garden. Her teacher smiled and said thank you.

Ben could not find his pencil case. He looked under his desk and inside his bag, but it was not there. He felt worried because the Math class was about to start. Then his seatmate, Lisa, noticed he was looking around. She lent him a pencil and a sharpener. Ben said thank you and finished his work on time.

The school held a poster-making contest about caring for the environment. Mia wanted to join, but she was nervous because her classmate Carlo always won art contests. She almost gave up, but her friend Joy reminded her that her drawings of animals were always full of life. On the day of the contest, Mia drew a forest with animals picking up trash. She did not win first place, but her poster was chosen as the most creative entry. Mia realized that joining was already a victory.

Every afternoon, Ramon passed by an old man selling newspapers near the school gate. One day, it was raining hard and no one was buying. Ramon only had enough money for his snack, but he stopped and bought one newspaper he didn't need. The old man looked up, surprised. As Ramon walked away, he heard the man say quietly, "Salamat, anak." Ramon did not tell anyone what he did. That night, he could not explain why, but he felt lighter than usual.
